fields.name: leftCard
fields.label: Left card (tips, with check icons)
fields.description: In this order: 1) a paragraph with the small label, e.g. SMART BORROWING. 2) the heading, as Heading 2. 3) one bulleted list. In each bullet: the lead-in in bold, then the sentence, all on one line (do not press Enter inside a bullet).

fields.name: rightCard
fields.label: Right card (things to know, with alert icons)
fields.description: In this order: 1) a paragraph with the small label, e.g. READ BEFORE YOU BORROW. 2) the heading, as Heading 2. 3) one bulleted list. In each bullet: the lead-in in bold, then the sentence, all on one line (do not press Enter inside a bullet).
